summary: End-to-end testing of ARCHIVE LAB MVP completed. 35/35 backend pytest cases pass covering public catalog, auth, guest checkout, demo payment, reservation anti-double-sale, admin RBAC, admin CRUD, units generation, QR, CSV export, settings/content, and image upload. Frontend E2E flows all pass: home → /archivo (4 cards shown, denim filter narrows to 1) → product dossier → size pick → add-to-cart → /carrito → /checkout (requires name+email+address) → /checkout/demo/{order_id} → demo approve → /payment-result shows unit code (AL-DNM01-002-E28D). Auth login/register works, token stored at localStorage['archive_token']. VIP /camila-guerra correctly shows locked state when logged out and 1 VIP piece when logged in. /mi-archivo renders with claim-order-input and logout-button. Admin RBAC: customer accessing /admin is redirected to /; admin login grants access to /admin with new-product-button and all tabs.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 844 lines - consider splitting into modules (auth, products, checkout, admin) for maintainability.

CORSMiddleware uses allow_credentials=False with allow_origins='*' - fine for current Bearer-token flow but note that any future httpOnly cookie auth would need explicit origins and allow_credentials=True.
release_expired() is awaited on every GET /api/products and /api/products/{id} and loops all 'reservada' units - will not scale; use a periodic background task or a TTL index.
Admin product delete deletes units of 'disponible/retirada' silently, which permanently loses unit history; consider soft-archive instead.

Review-request mentioned data-testid 'admin-tab-productos' but implementation uses 'admin-tab-piezas' (visible label is PIEZAS). Minor naming inconsistency vs. spec - update either spec or data-testid for consistency.
Auth route is '/ingresar' (Spanish) - fine, but the review request's agent note referenced generic selectors; the data-testids themselves (auth-email/password/submit) are correct and present.

seed_data_creation: Backend seeds demo products (DNM01, INT01, CAR01, CG01, VST01) and admin user on startup. Tests created guest orders prefixed with TEST_* emails (TEST_guest@test.com, TEST_e2e@test.com, TEST_double@test.com, TEST_other@test.com) and one TEST_Prod product that was deleted at end of CRUD test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public auth route is /ingresar (NOT /auth). Checkout requires address when shipping_method='envio' - don't skip. Backend demo mode active (MP_ACCESS_TOKEN empty) - POST /api/demo/approve/{order_id} marks orders paid. Admin tab 'piezas' not 'productos'. All data-testids working. Reservation TTL is 20 min - running tests back-to-back may consume CAR01 (6 units) and INT01 (4 units) availability. If re-running, reservations without demo-approve stay for 20min before auto-release.
rca of the issue: No bugs identified. Initial frontend attempt failed only because I used /auth path - correct path is /ingresar. Also /checkout pay-button requires valid shipping address when shipping_method is 'envio' - validation works correctly.
